title: Verdict
description: verdicts/<quest>-<n>.json: the judgement on attempt n of a quest. Written by a judge in a fresh session spawned by the Steward, by the Steward itself (`machine`: script tier or verifier_same_family = machine_only), or by the owner (`user`: royal seal or return, weighs 3x in reputation; file <quest>-<n>-user.json). A partial verdict, left by a judge stopped before the end, is <quest>-<n>-p<k>.json, k counting the verifier sessions of run n. Machine checks run before the judge and are the primary judge.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Not expressible here, checked by zod: id = quest_id + '-' + attempt, followed by -p<k> only when result = partial and by -user only when by_human = true; a character verdict (verifier_id neither user nor machine) has a session_id. Not checked by this schema because they need the quest or the registry, enforced by validateVerdict in packages/domain: verifier_id is neither the assignee nor anyone who worked the quest; a character verdict is valid only if session_id belongs to a verifier attempt in quest.attempt_log spawned by the Steward (never a sub-agent of the worker); under pass_rule all_checks_and_agent or checks_only, result is never pass while any check has pass = false. Enforced by the Steward when a judge hands a verdict in, not here, so files written before P1-40 stay valid: a judge's pass has notes, and in a scratch plot whose ritual breaks code it has at least two breaks, else it is taken as partial.

verifier_id.description: A character slug, or `user` (royal seal), or `machine` (Steward-issued verdict from machine checks).

fail_kind.description: Classified so 'same kind of failure' can be counted (same_fail_suspend).

notes.description: Required and specific when result = fail. Written in kingdom.owner.locale; identifiers, commands, paths and error text verbatim.

progress.description: For partial verdicts: where the next verifier continues reading.

breaks.description: The judge's breaks in a scratch plot (ritual step break_and_expect_red, P1-40): each change it made on purpose to the code the tests guard, and the red run it caused. There a judge's pass without at least two is taken by the Steward as partial.

change.description: What the judge broke on purpose in its scratch plot: the file, the line and the change.

red.description: The command it ran on the break and the tests that went red.

rejudge.description: Only on the owner's return (`elvaria return --rejudge`, P1-40): the quest goes back for a new judgement because the judge erred, not the assignee, so the assignee's reputation and fail streak do not count it.

examples.notes: Script `pnpm check` gọi `pnpm test` trước `pnpm i18n:check` nhưng `packages/shared` có 2 test đỏ (`scoring/effective-level.spec.ts`). README mục "Kiểm tra trước khi push" vẫn ghi lệnh cũ. Sửa test hoặc thứ tự, cập nhật README, nộp lại.
